rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade disables the tenant-isolation FORCE/RLS policies restored on the pre-existing northstar_identity.subject and session tables (returning them to their 000003 application-layer-scoped state), then drops the tenant-isolation policies and the impersonation_grant, break_glass_access and post_use_review tables this migration created. The new tables hold only impersonation/break-glass session-mode records; subjects, users, sessions and credentials are untouched, so a rollback affects no other module's data. On a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
the northstar_identity.subject and session tables exist with a tenant_scope column
postchecks: northstar_identity now contains the impersonation_grant, break_glass_access and post_use_review tables

row-level security is enabled and forced with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC on every new impersonation/break-glass table AND on the pre-existing subject and session tables
